assessment.reasoning: As of April 26, 2026, BTC is trading around $77,500–$78,200 (CoinDesk: $78,060; Fortune Apr 24: $78,126; Yahoo Finance: $77,508). The $80,000 threshold requires approximately a 2.5–3.3% move higher from current levels. There are only ~4–5 days remaining in April (resolution at 11:59 PM ET April 30). Bitcoin has had a strong April, up ~13.7% month-to-date per Coinbase, but momentum appears to be stalling below $78,200 with open interest declining. The monthly high so far appears to be around $78,200 (Apr 22 9am print of $78,194), still ~$1,800–$2,200 shy of the $80k target. A ~2.5% rally in 4 remaining days is plausible but non-trivial — implied vol is elevated (~40–50% annualized per mid-April analysis), which on a 4-day window implies roughly a 1.5–2% daily standard deviation, making a single-spike to $80k achievable but not probable in the absence of a strong catalyst. FOMC on April 28–29 is a known near-term catalyst. Base rate: 1-minute candle 'touch' gives a slightly higher probability than a close-based measure, but not dramatically so given how close we are to month-end. With ~4 days left and a ~2.5% gap to fill, probability is estimated at ~40–45%.
